newsitem.title: JAPAN: All Tokyo corn futures contracts end lower.
newsitem.headline: All Tokyo corn futures contracts end lower.

text.p: All Tokyo corn futures contracts closed lower on Thursday after technical selling from individual investors emegred following Wednesday's price rallies.
Prices were 150 to 310 yen lower, with the benchmark September 1997 contract down 310 yen at 15,690 yen per tonne.

All the futures were lower in the morning on technical selling, but gradually recovered by early afternoon, traders said. Weaker corn trading on the CBOT overnight accelerated bearish sentiment, and investors rushed to sell, they said.

The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.92-1/2 per bushel at 0815 GMT, against $2.92-3/4 at Wednesday's close. Spot November of the CBOT soybean futures was at $7.44 a bushel at 0815 GMT, against $7.42 on Wednesday.
